heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: Manggarai Timur extended its own emergency status a third time on 20 September, through 26 September, as a 21 September M5.3 aftershock collapsed one under-construction temporary-shelter (huntara) unit in Satar Kampas — no casualties, officials say, attributing it to incomplete construction rather than faulty materials. The regency's task force now puts verified housing damage at 26,185 units, including 2,458 severely damaged. Separately, The Jakarta Post reported that the earthquake's death-toll breakdown — 94 of 142 deaths occurring in shelters after the disaster, versus 48 killed directly — has drawn calls from critics for an independent investigation, a disproportion BNPB attributes largely to evacuees with pre-existing chronic conditions.
